Programming Language Reference: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets)
Version: CSS Snapshot 2023 / CSS3 & CSS4 Modules (W3C)
Syntax: Rule-based stylesheet language composed of selectors, declarations, properties, and values.
Semantics: Cascade algorithm, specificity rules, inheritance, Box Model, formatting contexts (Flexbox, Grid).
Type System: Property value types: lengths (px, rem, vh), colors (rgb, oklch), percentages, custom properties (--var).
Memory Model: Computed style maps and render tree layout nodes maintained by browser styling engine.
Concurrency: Hardware-accelerated compositing on separate GPU threads (transforms, opacity).
Error Handling: Forward-compatible error recovery: invalid property-value pairs or unrecognized selectors are safely ignored.
Standard APIs: CSS Object Model (CSSOM), CSS Typed OM API, CSS Grid Layout, CSS Flexible Box
Specification: W3C CSS Specifications (https://www.w3.org/Style/CSS/current-work)
Official Docs: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS
